title: The Harbor of Maple Hollow
author: Ines Voss
blurb: Jude Kavanagh, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
